en.headline: Tai Kwun exhibition celebrates brotherhood in classic Hong Kong films
en.dek: Better Together – Partnering Up for Hong Kong Movies runs until 4 October, recreating iconic scenes from films including Once a Thief and Police Story 3.
body: Tai Kwun’s summer exhibition Better Together – Partnering Up for Hong Kong Movies continues through the weekend and until 4 October in the Duplex Studio of the Police Headquarters Block. The show explores the Cantonese ethos of paak zyu soeng, or team spirit, as portrayed in Hong Kong cinema since the 1960s.

Visitors can walk through immersive recreations of scenes from eight films and sequels, among them the upside-down heist from Once a Thief starring Chow Yun-fat, robotic figures from Aces Go Places 2 and Gen-Y Cops, and the helicopter-and-motorbike sequence from Police Story 3 – Super Cop.

The exhibition is organised by Tai Kwun Centre for Heritage and Art at 10 Hollywood Road, Central. Tickets are available online; the venue is open daily. The organisers said the display highlights camaraderie as a recurring theme across decades of local filmmaking.

zh.headline: 大館展覽探索港產片中的兄弟情義
zh.dek: 「拍住上——香港電影中的夥伴情誼」展出至10月4日，重現《縱橫四海》《警察故事3》等經典場景。
body: 大館夏季展覽「拍住上——香港電影中的夥伴情誼」本周末繼續開放，展期至10月4日，於警察總部大樓複式工作室舉行。展覽探討六十年代以來港產片中「拍住上」的團隊精神。
參觀者可走進八部電影及續集的沉浸式場景重現，包括周潤發主演《縱橫四海》的倒轉盜寶場面、《最佳拍檔》系列與《特警新人類》的機械人對比，以及《警察故事3：超級警察》的直升機與電單車追逐。
展覽由大館文物藝術館主辦，地址中環荷李活道10號。門票可於網上購買，場地每日開放。主辦單位表示，展覽突顯夥伴情誼作為本地電影數十年來的常見主題。
